```{r ui}
      withSpinner(leafletOutput("map", height = 600), type = 6),
      textOutput("statusText")
```

``` {r functions}
# testing out a new prism option
get_prism_data <- function(month,
                           year,
                           variable = c("ppt","tmin","tmax","tmean","tdmean","vpdmin","vpdmax"),
                           resolution = c("4km","800m","400m"),
                           region = "us",
                           dataset = c("AN", "LT"),
                           keep_zip = FALSE,
                           overwrite = FALSE,
                           cache_dir = tools::R_user_dir("fecundity_prism_rasters", which = "cache")) {

  if (!requireNamespace("httr", quietly = TRUE)) {
    stop("Package 'httr' is required. Install it with install.packages('httr').", call. = FALSE)
  }
  if (!requireNamespace("terra", quietly = TRUE)) {
    stop("Package 'terra' is required. Install it with install.packages('terra').", call. = FALSE)
  }

  dataset    <- match.arg(dataset)
  resolution <- match.arg(resolution)
  variable   <- match.arg(variable)

  month <- as.integer(month)
  year  <- as.integer(year)
  if (is.na(month) || month < 1L || month > 12L) stop("'month' must be 1..12.", call. = FALSE)
  if (is.na(year)  || year  < 1895L) stop("'year' must be >= 1895.", call. = FALSE)

  yyyymm <- sprintf("%04d%02d", year, month)

  # --- Check persistent raster cache first to avoid re-downloading ---
  if (!is.null(cache_dir)) {
    dir.create(cache_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
    cached_tif <- file.path(cache_dir,
                            sprintf("prism_%s_%s_%s_%s_%s.tif", variable, region, resolution, dataset, yyyymm))
    if (file.exists(cached_tif) && !overwrite) {
      r_file <- terra::rast(cached_tif)
      vals   <- terra::values(r_file, mat = TRUE)
      r_mem  <- terra::rast(r_file)
      terra::values(r_mem) <- vals
      names(r_mem) <- names(r_file)
      return(r_mem)
    }
  }

  # Temp directory that will be removed at function exit
  out_dir <- file.path(tempdir(), sprintf("prism_%s_%s_%s_%s_%s",
                                          variable, region, resolution, dataset, yyyymm))
  dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

  on.exit({
    if (dir.exists(out_dir)) unlink(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, force = TRUE)
  }, add = TRUE)

  url <- sprintf("https://services.nacse.org/prism/data/get/%s/%s/%s/%s",
                 region, resolution, variable, yyyymm)
  if (dataset == "LT") url <- paste0(url, "/lt")

  zip_path <- file.path(out_dir, sprintf("prism_%s_%s_%s_%s.zip",
                                         variable, region, resolution, yyyymm))
  if (file.exists(zip_path) && overwrite) unlink(zip_path)

  resp <- httr::GET(
    url,
    httr::write_disk(zip_path, overwrite = TRUE),
    httr::user_agent("R (get_prism_data)")
  )

  # Fail fast on HTTP errors
  httr::stop_for_status(resp)

  # ---- validate we actually got a ZIP ----
  if (!file.exists(zip_path) || is.na(file.info(zip_path)$size) || file.info(zip_path)$size < 100L) {
    stop("Download did not create a valid file on disk.", call. = FALSE)
  }

  sig <- readBin(zip_path, what = "raw", n = 2)
  is_zip <- length(sig) == 2 && identical(sig, charToRaw("PK"))
  if (!is_zip) {
    # Try to show the beginning of the server response for debugging
    txt <- tryCatch(readLines(zip_path, warn = FALSE, n = 20), error = function(e) character())
    snippet <- paste(txt, collapse = "\n")
    if (nchar(snippet) > 800) snippet <- substr(snippet, 1, 800)
    stop(
      paste0(
        "PRISM did not return a ZIP for this request.\n",
        "URL: ", url, "\n\n",
        "First part of response:\n", snippet
      ),
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  # Now it's safe to inspect the zip
  files_in_zip <- utils::unzip(zip_path, list = TRUE)$Name
  tif_candidates <- files_in_zip[grepl("\\.tif$", files_in_zip, ignore.case = TRUE)]
  if (length(tif_candidates) == 0L) {
    stop("Downloaded ZIP did not contain a .tif file.", call. = FALSE)
  }

  utils::unzip(zip_path, exdir = out_dir, overwrite = overwrite)

  tif_path <- file.path(out_dir, tif_candidates[1])
  if (!file.exists(tif_path)) {
    tif_found <- list.files(out_dir, pattern = "\\.tif$", recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)
    if (length(tif_found) > 0L) tif_path <- tif_found[1]
  }
  if (!file.exists(tif_path)) stop("Unzip succeeded but could not locate extracted .tif.", call. = FALSE)

  if (!keep_zip && file.exists(zip_path)) unlink(zip_path)

  # ---- load into memory so temp files can be deleted safely ----
  r_file <- terra::rast(tif_path)

  # Save to persistent cache before temp dir is deleted
  if (!is.null(cache_dir)) {
    tryCatch(terra::writeRaster(r_file, cached_tif, overwrite = TRUE), error = function(e) NULL)
  }

  # Force read values and rebuild an in-memory raster (no on-disk dependency)
  vals <- terra::values(r_file, mat = TRUE)  # works for 1+ layers
  r_mem <- terra::rast(r_file)
  terra::values(r_mem) <- vals
  names(r_mem) <- names(r_file)

  r_mem
}

get_prism_normals_data <- function(mon = NULL,
                                   annual = FALSE,
                                   variable = c("ppt","tmin","tmax","tmean","tdmean","vpdmin","vpdmax"),
                                   resolution = c("4km","800m"),
                                   region = c("us","ak"),
                                   normals_end_year = 2020,
                                   keep_zip = FALSE,
                                   overwrite = FALSE,
                                   cache_dir = tools::R_user_dir("fecundity_prism_rasters", which = "cache")) {

  if (!requireNamespace("httr", quietly = TRUE)) {
    stop("Package 'httr' is required. Install it with install.packages('httr').", call. = FALSE)
  }
  if (!requireNamespace("terra", quietly = TRUE)) {
    stop("Package 'terra' is required. Install it with install.packages('terra').", call. = FALSE)
  }

  variable   <- match.arg(variable)
  resolution <- match.arg(resolution)
  region     <- match.arg(region)

  # Normals file naming uses PRISM resolution codes (e.g., 25m for 4km, 30s for 800m).  [oai_citation:2‡PRISM Group](https://prism.oregonstate.edu/formats)
  res_code <- switch(resolution,
                     "4km"  = "25m",
                     "800m" = "30s")

  # Decide temporal subfolder + filename suffix
  if (isTRUE(annual)) {
    temporal <- "monthly"   # annual normals live alongside monthly in PRISM normals dirs (see example listing).  [oai_citation:3‡Oregon State Data Portal](https://data.prism.oregonstate.edu/normals/us/4km/ppt/monthly/)
    date_tag <- sprintf("%04d", as.integer(normals_end_year))
  } else {
    if (is.null(mon)) stop("Provide mon=1..12 for monthly normals, or set annual=TRUE.", call. = FALSE)
    mon <- as.integer(mon)
    if (is.na(mon) || mon < 1L || mon > 12L) stop("'mon' must be an integer 1..12.", call. = FALSE)
    temporal <- "monthly"
    date_tag <- sprintf("%04d%02d", as.integer(normals_end_year), mon)
  }

  zip_name <- sprintf("prism_%s_%s_%s_%s_avg_30y.zip", variable, region, res_code, date_tag)

  # --- Check persistent raster cache first ---
  if (!is.null(cache_dir)) {
    dir.create(cache_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
    cached_tif <- file.path(cache_dir, sub("\\.zip$", ".tif", zip_name))
    if (file.exists(cached_tif) && !overwrite) {
      message("Cache hit: ", basename(cached_tif))
      r_file <- terra::rast(cached_tif)
      vals   <- terra::values(r_file, mat = TRUE)
      r_mem  <- terra::rast(r_file)
      terra::values(r_mem) <- vals
      names(r_mem) <- names(r_file)
      return(r_mem)
    }
  }

  # Build URL like:
  # https://data.prism.oregonstate.edu/normals/us/4km/ppt/monthly/prism_ppt_us_25m_202002_avg_30y.zip  [oai_citation:4‡Oregon State Data Portal](https://data.prism.oregonstate.edu/normals/us/4km/ppt/monthly/)
  url <- sprintf("https://data.prism.oregonstate.edu/normals/%s/%s/%s/%s/%s",
                 region, resolution, variable, temporal, zip_name)

  # Unique temp folder per call (Shiny-safe)
  out_dir <- tempfile("prism_normals_")
  dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  on.exit({
    if (dir.exists(out_dir)) unlink(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, force = TRUE)
  }, add = TRUE)

  zip_path <- file.path(out_dir, zip_name)
  if (file.exists(zip_path) && overwrite) unlink(zip_path)

  resp <- httr::GET(
    url,
    httr::write_disk(zip_path, overwrite = TRUE),
    httr::user_agent("R (get_prism_normals_data)")
  )
  httr::stop_for_status(resp)

  # Validate ZIP signature (avoid HTML/redirects saved as .zip)
  sig <- readBin(zip_path, what = "raw", n = 2)
  if (!(length(sig) == 2 && identical(sig, charToRaw("PK")))) {
    txt <- tryCatch(readLines(zip_path, warn = FALSE, n = 20), error = function(e) character())
    snippet <- paste(txt, collapse = "\n")
    if (nchar(snippet) > 800) snippet <- substr(snippet, 1, 800)
    stop(paste0("PRISM normals download did not return a ZIP.\nURL: ", url, "\n\nResponse head:\n", snippet),
         call. = FALSE)
  }

  # Find and unzip the GeoTIFF inside
  files_in_zip <- utils::unzip(zip_path, list = TRUE)$Name
  tif_candidates <- files_in_zip[grepl("\\.tif$", files_in_zip, ignore.case = TRUE)]
  if (length(tif_candidates) == 0L) stop("Downloaded ZIP did not contain a .tif file.", call. = FALSE)

  utils::unzip(zip_path, exdir = out_dir, overwrite = overwrite)
  tif_path <- file.path(out_dir, tif_candidates[1])

  if (!file.exists(tif_path)) {
    tif_found <- list.files(out_dir, pattern = "\\.tif$", recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)
    if (length(tif_found) > 0L) tif_path <- tif_found[1]
  }
  if (!file.exists(tif_path)) stop("Unzip succeeded but could not locate extracted .tif.", call. = FALSE)

  if (!keep_zip && file.exists(zip_path)) unlink(zip_path)

  # Load + force into memory so temp files can be deleted safely
  r_file <- terra::rast(tif_path)

  # Save to persistent cache before temp dir is deleted
  if (!is.null(cache_dir)) {
    tryCatch(terra::writeRaster(r_file, cached_tif, overwrite = TRUE), error = function(e) NULL)
  }

  vals   <- terra::values(r_file, mat = TRUE)
  r_mem  <- terra::rast(r_file)
  terra::values(r_mem) <- vals
  names(r_mem) <- names(r_file)

  r_mem
}

# ---- shared helper: build the full phase-params table --------------------
# (used by both getClimate and getNorm to look up months/lags per phase)
build_params_table <- function() {
  pine_params <- data.frame(
    Taxa  = rep(c("Pinus ponderosa","Pinus jeffreyi","Pinus contorta",
                  "Pinus lambertiana","Pinus monticola"), each = 9),
    Phase = rep(c("temp_budInit","temp_Poll","temp_Fert",
                  "ppt_budInit","ppt_budInit","ppt_Poll","ppt_Poll",
                  "ppt_Fert","ppt_Fert"), times = 5),
    Time  = rep(c(-2,-1,0,-3,-2,-2,-1,-1,0), times = 5)
  )
  pine_params$Month <- rep(list(
    7:11, 3:9, 4:11, 10:12, 1:4, 10:12, 1:4, 10:12, 1:4
  ), times = 5)

  agrifolia_params <- data.frame(
    Taxa  = rep("Quercus agrifolia", 10),
    Phase = c("temp_budInit","temp_budInit","temp_Poll","temp_Fert",
              "ppt_budInit","ppt_budInit","ppt_Poll","ppt_Poll",
              "ppt_Fert","ppt_Fert"),
    Time  = c(-1,0,0,0,-2,-1,-1,0,-1,0)
  )
  agrifolia_params$Month <- list(
    6:10, 3:5, 4:6, 5:7, 10:12, 1:4, 10:12, 1:4, 10:12, 1:4
  )

  oak_params <- data.frame(
    Taxa  = rep(c("Quercus kelloggii","Quercus chrysolepis"), each = 10),
    Phase = rep(c("temp_budInit","temp_budInit","temp_Poll","temp_Fert",
                  "ppt_budInit","ppt_budInit","ppt_Poll","ppt_Poll",
                  "ppt_Fert","ppt_Fert"), times = 2),
    Time  = rep(c(-2,-1,-1,-1,-3,-2,-2,-1,-1,0), times = 2)
  )
  oak_params$Month <- rep(list(
    6:10, 3:5, 4:6, 5:7, 10:12, 1:4, 10:12, 1:4, 10:12, 1:4
  ), times = 2)

  fir_params <- data.frame(
    Taxa  = rep(c("Abies magnifica","Abies grandis","Abies concolor"), each = 10),
    Phase = rep(c("temp_budInit","temp_budInit","temp_Poll","temp_Fert",
                  "ppt_budInit","ppt_budInit","ppt_Poll","ppt_Poll",
                  "ppt_Fert","ppt_Fert"), times = 3),
    Time  = rep(c(-1,0,0,0,-2,-1,-1,0,0,0), times = 3)
  )
  fir_params$Month <- rep(list(
    4:11, 4, 3:6, 5:9, 10:12, 1:4, 10:12, 1:4, 10:12, 1:4
  ), times = 3)

  rbind(pine_params, agrifolia_params, oak_params, fir_params)
}

# ---- fast getClimate: table lookup, no raster I/O -----------------------
# Requires CLIM_MONTHLY to be loaded in the calling environment or .GlobalEnv.
# CLIM_MONTHLY columns: TREE_ID, year, month, tmean, ppt
getClimate <- function(species, year,
                       clim_table  = get("CLIM_MONTHLY",  envir = .GlobalEnv),
                       tree_names  = get("treeNames",     envir = .GlobalEnv)) {
  trees  <- dplyr::filter(tree_names, Species %in% species) |>
    dplyr::select(Species, TREE_ID) |> dplyr::distinct()

  params <- dplyr::filter(build_params_table(), Taxa %in% species)
  ppt_phases <- c("ppt_budInit", "ppt_Fert", "ppt_Poll")

  rows <- vector("list", nrow(params))
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(params))) {
    p      <- params[i, ]
    phase  <- p$Phase
    mon    <- as.integer(unlist(p$Month))
    var    <- if (grepl("temp", phase)) "tmean" else "ppt"
    lag_yr <- as.integer(p$Time) + year

    rows[[i]] <- clim_table |>
      dplyr::filter(Species %in% trees$Species,
                    TREE_ID %in% trees$TREE_ID,
                    .data$year == lag_yr,
                    month %in% mon) |>
      dplyr::left_join(trees, by = c("Species", "TREE_ID")) |>
      dplyr::group_by(Species, TREE_ID) |>
      dplyr::summarize(
        Value = if (var == "tmean") mean(.data[["tmean"]], na.rm = TRUE)
                else                sum(.data[["ppt"]],   na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) |>
      dplyr::mutate(Year = year, Phase = phase)
  }

  dplyr::bind_rows(rows) |>
    dplyr::group_by(Species, TREE_ID, Year, Phase) |>
    dplyr::summarize(
      Value = if (Phase[1] %in% ppt_phases) sum(Value) else mean(Value),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    dplyr::distinct()
}

# ---- fast getNorm: table lookup, no raster I/O --------------------------
# Requires NORM_MONTHLY to be loaded in the calling environment or .GlobalEnv.
# NORM_MONTHLY columns: TREE_ID, month, tmean, ppt
getNorm <- function(species, year,
                    norm_table  = get("NORM_MONTHLY", envir = .GlobalEnv),
                    tree_names  = get("treeNames",    envir = .GlobalEnv)) {
  trees  <- dplyr::filter(tree_names, Species %in% species) |>
    dplyr::select(Species, TREE_ID) |> dplyr::distinct()

  params <- dplyr::filter(build_params_table(), Taxa %in% species)
  ppt_phases <- c("ppt_budInit", "ppt_Fert", "ppt_Poll")

  rows <- vector("list", nrow(params))
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(params))) {
    p     <- params[i, ]
    phase <- p$Phase
    mon   <- as.integer(unlist(p$Month))
    var   <- if (grepl("temp", phase)) "tmean" else "ppt"

    rows[[i]] <- norm_table |>
      dplyr::filter(Species %in% trees$Species,
                    TREE_ID %in% trees$TREE_ID,
                    month %in% mon) |>
      dplyr::left_join(trees, by = c("Species", "TREE_ID")) |>
      dplyr::group_by(Species, TREE_ID) |>
      dplyr::summarize(
        normValue = if (var == "tmean") mean(.data[["tmean"]], na.rm = TRUE)
                    else                sum(.data[["ppt"]],    na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) |>
      dplyr::mutate(Year = year, Phase = phase)
  }

  dplyr::bind_rows(rows) |>
    dplyr::group_by(Species, TREE_ID, Year, Phase) |>
    dplyr::summarize(
      normValue = if (Phase[1] %in% ppt_phases) sum(normValue) else mean(normValue),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    dplyr::distinct()
}

# calculate fecundity
getFecundity <- function(Species) {

  sp_name_map <- c(
    quercusChrysole = "Quercus chrysolepis",
    quercusKelloggi = "Quercus kelloggii",
    quercusAgrifoli = "Quercus agrifolia",
    pinusContorta   = "Pinus contorta",
    pinusJeffreyi   = "Pinus jeffreyi",
    pinusLamberti   = "Pinus lambertiana",
    pinusMonticol   = "Pinus monticola",
    pinusPonderos   = "Pinus ponderosa",
    abiesConcolor   = "Abies concolor",
    abiesMagnific   = "Abies magnifica",
    abiesGrandis    = "Abies grandis"
  )

  # Read each genus CSV only once, then combine with bind_rows
  genera <- unique(sub(" .*", "", Species))

  coefs_list <- lapply(genera, function(genus) {
    cpath <- if (genus == "Pinus") {
      'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/emoran5/FecundityShinyApp/refs/heads/main/Pinus_model1_f5_betas.csv'
    } else if (genus == "Quercus") {
      'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/emoran5/FecundityShinyApp/refs/heads/main/Quercus_model1_f4_betas.csv'
    } else if (genus == "Abies") {
      'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/emoran5/FecundityShinyApp/refs/heads/main/Abies_model2_f2_betas.csv'
    } else {
      stop(paste("Unknown genus:", genus))
    }

    read.csv(cpath) %>%
      mutate(X = gsub("species", "", X)) %>%
      separate(X, c('Species', 'var1', 'var2'), sep = ":", fill = "right") %>%
      mutate(
        var1 = ifelse(is.na(var1), "Intercept", var1),
        var2 = ifelse(is.na(var2), "none",      var2)
      ) %>%
      filter(var1 != "shade", var2 != "shade") %>%
      mutate(Species = dplyr::recode(Species, !!!sp_name_map)) %>%
      drop_na() %>%
      mutate(
        beta_obs    = estimate,
        interaction = ifelse(var2 != "none", paste(var1, var2, sep = ":"), var1)
      ) %>%
      dplyr::select(Species, interaction, beta_obs) %>%
      # values_fn = first prevents list-columns when duplicate interactions exist
      pivot_wider(names_from = interaction, values_from = beta_obs,
                  values_fn = first)
  })

  dplyr::bind_rows(coefs_list)

}


getSeeds <- function(data, tree_data) {
  Spec <- unique(data$Species)
  
  coefs <- getFecundity(Spec)
  
  output <- data %>%
    dplyr::select(Species, TREE_ID)
  
  results <- data.frame(NULL)
  
  for(i in Spec) {
    
    output2  <- filter(output, Species == i)
    beta_new <- filter(coefs, Species == i)
    data_new <- filter(data, Species == i)

    # Fill any coefficient column absent from this species' model with 0.
    # (Missing column -> predictor not used in model -> zero contribution.)
    all_beta_cols <- c(
      "Intercept", "diam", "I(diam^2)",
      "precip_budInit", "I(precip_budInit^2)", "diam:precip_budInit",
      "temp_budInit",   "I(temp_budInit^2)",   "diam:temp_budInit",
      "ppt_Poll",       "I(ppt_Poll^2)",        "diam:ppt_Poll",
      "tmean_Poll",     "I(tmean_Poll^2)",      "diam:tmean_Poll",
      "ppt_Fert",       "diam:ppt_Fert",
      "tmean_Fert",     "I(tmean_Fert^2)",      "diam:tmean_Fert"
    )
    for (col in all_beta_cols) {
      if (!col %in% names(beta_new) || is.na(beta_new[[col]])) beta_new[[col]] <- 0
    }
    
  
  # Baseline: intercept + diameter terms only (all climate anomalies = 0).
  # Seeds - baseline = log change in fecundity due to climate (unitless, comparable across species).
  # NOTE: quadratic coefficient names (e.g. I(diam^2)) reflect how MASTIF built its design matrix;
  # the predictors were already squared before model fitting, so we do NOT re-square them here.
  Seeds_baseline <- beta_new$Intercept +
    beta_new$diam        * data_new$diam +
    beta_new$`I(diam^2)` * data_new$diam

  if(i %in% c("Pinus ponderosa", "Pinus jeffreyi", "Pinus contorta", "Pinus lambertiana", "Pinus monticola")) {

    output2$Seeds <- beta_new$Intercept +
      beta_new$diam * data_new$diam +
      beta_new$`I(diam^2)` * data_new$diam +
      beta_new$precip_budInit * data_new$ppt_budInit +
      beta_new$`I(precip_budInit^2)` * data_new$ppt_budInit +
      beta_new$temp_budInit * data_new$temp_budInit +
      beta_new$`I(temp_budInit^2)` * data_new$temp_budInit +
      beta_new$tmean_Poll * data_new$temp_Poll +
      beta_new$tmean_Fert * data_new$temp_Fert +
      beta_new$ppt_Poll * data_new$ppt_Poll +
      beta_new$ppt_Fert * data_new$ppt_Fert +
      beta_new$`diam:precip_budInit` * data_new$diam * data_new$ppt_budInit +
      beta_new$`diam:temp_budInit` * data_new$diam * data_new$temp_budInit +
      beta_new$`diam:tmean_Poll` * data_new$diam * data_new$temp_Poll +
      beta_new$`diam:tmean_Fert` * data_new$diam * data_new$temp_Fert +
      beta_new$`diam:ppt_Poll` * data_new$diam * data_new$ppt_Poll +
      beta_new$`diam:ppt_Fert` * data_new$diam * data_new$ppt_Fert
    output2$Seeds <- output2$Seeds - Seeds_baseline
  
} else if(i %in% c("Quercus agrifolia", "Quercus kelloggii", "Quercus chrysolepis")) {
  
    output2$Seeds <- beta_new$Intercept +
      beta_new$diam * data_new$diam +
      beta_new$`I(diam^2)` * data_new$diam +
      beta_new$precip_budInit * data_new$ppt_budInit +
      beta_new$`diam:precip_budInit` * data_new$diam * data_new$ppt_budInit +
      beta_new$temp_budInit * data_new$temp_budInit +
      beta_new$`I(temp_budInit^2)` * data_new$temp_budInit +
      beta_new$`diam:temp_budInit` * data_new$diam * data_new$temp_budInit +
      beta_new$ppt_Poll * data_new$ppt_Poll +
      beta_new$`diam:ppt_Poll` * data_new$diam * data_new$ppt_Poll +
      beta_new$tmean_Poll * data_new$temp_Poll +
      beta_new$`I(tmean_Poll^2)` * data_new$temp_Poll +
      beta_new$`diam:tmean_Poll` * data_new$diam * data_new$temp_Poll +
      beta_new$ppt_Fert * data_new$ppt_Fert +
      beta_new$`diam:ppt_Fert` * data_new$diam * data_new$ppt_Fert +
      beta_new$tmean_Fert * data_new$temp_Fert +
      beta_new$`I(tmean_Fert^2)` * data_new$temp_Fert +
      beta_new$`diam:tmean_Fert` * data_new$diam * data_new$temp_Fert
    output2$Seeds <- output2$Seeds - Seeds_baseline
    
} else if(i %in% c("Abies grandis", "Abies magnifica", "Abies concolor")) {
  
    output2$Seeds <- beta_new$Intercept +
      beta_new$diam * data_new$diam +
      beta_new$`I(diam^2)` * data_new$diam +
      beta_new$precip_budInit * data_new$ppt_budInit +
      beta_new$`I(precip_budInit^2)` * data_new$ppt_budInit +
      beta_new$`diam:precip_budInit` * data_new$diam * data_new$ppt_budInit +
      beta_new$temp_budInit * data_new$temp_budInit +
      beta_new$`I(temp_budInit^2)` * data_new$temp_budInit +
      beta_new$`diam:temp_budInit` * data_new$diam * data_new$temp_budInit +
      beta_new$ppt_Poll * data_new$ppt_Poll +
      beta_new$`I(ppt_Poll^2)` * data_new$ppt_Poll +
      beta_new$`diam:ppt_Poll` * data_new$diam * data_new$ppt_Poll +
      beta_new$tmean_Poll * data_new$temp_Poll +
      beta_new$`I(tmean_Poll^2)` * data_new$temp_Poll +
      beta_new$`diam:tmean_Poll` * data_new$diam * data_new$temp_Poll +
      beta_new$tmean_Fert * data_new$temp_Fert +
      beta_new$`I(tmean_Fert^2)` * data_new$temp_Fert +
      beta_new$`diam:tmean_Fert` * data_new$diam * data_new$temp_Fert
    output2$Seeds <- output2$Seeds - Seeds_baseline
    
}
    
    results <- rbind(results, output2)
  }

  # Join tree coordinates for mapping
  coords <- tree_data |>
    dplyr::ungroup() |>
    dplyr::select(Species, TREE_ID, UTMx, UTMy) |>
    dplyr::distinct() |>
    dplyr::rename(X = UTMx, Y = UTMy)

  results |> dplyr::left_join(coords, by = c("Species", "TREE_ID"))
}

# Jim did interpolate between measurement dates - assume DBH stays the same until the next measurement
```

```{r server}
library(shiny)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(leaflet)

# Fast path: load pre-extracted lookup tables if precompute_climate.R has been run.
# Fallback: use per-species-year file cache saved from previous raster-extraction runs.
# If using local computer directory update as needed.
CLIM_MONTHLY_PATH <- "~/Desktop/MASTIF cone tool/clim_monthly.rds"
NORM_MONTHLY_PATH <- "~/Desktop/MASTIF cone tool/norm_monthly.rds"
CLIM_MONTHLY <- if (file.exists(CLIM_MONTHLY_PATH)) readRDS(CLIM_MONTHLY_PATH) else NULL
NORM_MONTHLY <- if (file.exists(NORM_MONTHLY_PATH)) readRDS(NORM_MONTHLY_PATH) else NULL

# Per-species-year file cache (populated by previous raster-extraction runs).
RESULT_CACHE_DIR <- tools::R_user_dir("fecundity_results", which = "cache")
dir.create(RESULT_CACHE_DIR, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

.load_cached <- function(prefix, sp, yr) {
  key  <- paste0(prefix, "_", paste(sort(sp), collapse = "__"), "_", yr, ".rds")
  path <- file.path(RESULT_CACHE_DIR, key)
  if (file.exists(path)) readRDS(path) else NULL
}

server <- function(input, output, session) {

  status_msg <- reactiveVal("Select a year and species, then click 'Get Forecasts'.")

  # ---- your defined Species list (used to filter treeNames + UI options) ----
  Species <- sort(c(
    "Pinus ponderosa",
    "Pinus contorta",
    "Pinus jeffreyi",
    "Pinus lambertiana",
    "Pinus monticola",
    "Quercus kelloggii",
    "Quercus agrifolia",
    "Quercus chrysolepis",
    "Abies magnifica",
    "Abies grandis",
    "Abies concolor"
  ))

  # ---- build treeNames (FIA) once per session ----
  #change directory to your own
  treeNames <- reactive({
    readRDS("/Users/deedeehuebner/Desktop/MASTIF cone tool/treeNames.rds")
  })

  # ---- species choices (filtered to your Species list) ----
  observeEvent(treeNames(), {
    # Intersect just in case FIA names differ slightly
    sp <- sort(intersect(unique(treeNames()$Species), Species))
    updateCheckboxGroupInput(session, "species_selected", choices = sp, selected = sp)
  }, ignoreInit = FALSE)

  observeEvent(input$selectAll, {
    req(treeNames())
    sp <- sort(intersect(unique(treeNames()$Species), Species))
    updateCheckboxGroupInput(session, "species_selected", selected = sp)
  })

  observeEvent(input$uncheckAll, {
    updateCheckboxGroupInput(session, "species_selected", selected = character(0))
  })

  # ---- base map ----
  output$map <- renderLeaflet({
    leaflet(options = leafletOptions(zoomControl = TRUE, boxZoom = TRUE)) %>%
      addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron) %>%
      setView(lng = -119.418, lat = 36.778, zoom = 5)
  })

  # ---- compute forecasts on click ----
  seed_points <- eventReactive(input$runClimate, {
    req(input$year, input$species_selected, treeNames())

    tn <- treeNames()

    yr <- as.numeric(input$year)
    sp <- sort(input$species_selected)
    validate(need(length(sp) > 0, "Select at least one species."))
    status_msg("Computing forecasts...")

    if (!is.null(CLIM_MONTHLY) && !is.null(NORM_MONTHLY)) {
      clim_out <- getClimate(sp, yr, clim_table = CLIM_MONTHLY, tree_names = tn)
      norm_out <- getNorm(sp, yr, norm_table = NORM_MONTHLY,   tree_names = tn)
    } else {
      clim_out <- .load_cached("clim", sp, yr)
      norm_out  <- .load_cached("norm", sp, yr)
      if (is.null(clim_out) || is.null(norm_out)) {
        status_msg(paste0(
          "No cached data for: ", paste(sp, collapse=", "), " (", yr, "). ",
          "Run precompute_climate.R to enable all species/years."
        ))
        return(NULL)
      }
    }


    anom <- merge(clim_out, norm_out) |>
      dplyr::mutate(Value = Value - normValue) |>
      dplyr::select(Species, TREE_ID, Year, Phase, Value) |>
      tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Phase, values_from = Value) |>
      tidyr::drop_na() |>
      dplyr::left_join(
        tn |> dplyr::select(Species, TREE_ID, Diameter) |> dplyr::distinct(),
        by = c("Species", "TREE_ID")
      ) |>
      dplyr::rename(diam = Diameter)
    seeds <- getSeeds(anom, tn) |>
      dplyr::mutate(Seeds = log(abs(Seeds) + 1) * sign(Seeds))

    list(seeds = seeds, year = yr)
  }, ignoreInit = TRUE)

  observeEvent(seed_points(), ignoreNULL = TRUE, {
    tryCatch({
    res <- seed_points()
    if (is.null(res)) return()
    seeds <- res$seeds
    yr <- res$year

    if (is.null(seeds) || nrow(seeds) == 0) {
      status_msg("Error: getSeeds returned no rows.")
      return()
    }

    value_col <- dplyr::case_when(
      "Seeds"        %in% names(seeds) ~ "Seeds",
      "logF_current" %in% names(seeds) ~ "logF_current",
      "fecundity"    %in% names(seeds) ~ "fecundity",
      "Value"        %in% names(seeds) ~ "Value",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
    if (is.na(value_col)) {
      status_msg(paste("Error: no value column. names:", paste(names(seeds), collapse=", ")))
      return()
    }
    if (!all(c("X","Y") %in% names(seeds))) {
      status_msg(paste("Error: missing X/Y. names:", paste(names(seeds), collapse=", ")))
      return()
    }

    seeds <- seeds[!is.na(seeds[[value_col]]), ]
    vals <- seeds[[value_col]]
    pal  <- leaflet::colorNumeric(c("red", "blue"),vals, reverse = FALSE)
    leafletProxy("map", data = seeds) %>%
      clearMarkers() %>%
      clearControls() %>%
      addCircleMarkers(
        lng = ~X, lat = ~Y, radius = 3,
        color = pal(vals),
        opacity = 0.8,
        popup = ~paste0(
          "<b>Species:</b> ", Species, "<br>",
          "<b>Tree:</b> ", TREE_ID, "<br>",
          "<b>Year:</b> ", yr, "<br>",
          "<b>Predicted:</b> ", round(get(value_col), 3)
        )
      ) %>%
      addLegend("bottomright", pal = pal, values = vals,
                title = "Log \u0394 Fecundity", opacity = 1)

    status_msg(paste("Last run:", format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"),
                     "| Year:", yr, "| Points:", nrow(seeds)))
    }, error = function(e) {
      status_msg(paste("Error:", conditionMessage(e)))
    })
  }, ignoreInit = FALSE)

  output$statusText <- renderText(status_msg())
}
```

```{r app}
shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)
```
